nom: COSRX The Vitamin C 13 Serum with Super Vitamin E & Hyaluronic Acid

segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin who deals with hormonal acne reports pairing this with a skin peptide product made a noticeable difference in her skin.

concerns.aging: One reviewer reports the added hyaluronic acid helps reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles while deeply moisturizing the skin.
concerns.dehydration: The same reviewer credits the added hyaluronic acid with providing deep moisture alongside its anti-aging effect, though this is the only reviewer to comment on hydration directly.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports it calmed redness from acne scars and sun spots.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers report visibly more even skin tone and faded hyperpigmentation, sun spots, or acne scars, with some no longer needing foundation to even out their complexion.

aspects.libelle: Strong, off-putting smell for some users
Needs refrigeration to prevent color change or oxidation
13% strength good for daily use versus the 23% version
Gentle, no reaction even for cautious first-time users
